SpringDofInline: A scalar spring that holds its own stiffness (no property).
SpringDofInlineExplicit: The scalar spring that holds its own stiffness (no property), with the coordinate system its direction is given in.
SpringDofProperty: A scalar spring that refers to a SpringProp property.
SpringDofPropertyExplicit: The scalar spring that names a property, with the coordinate system its direction is given in.
SpringOffsetExplicit: Defines a discrete spring with offsets between its attachment points in an explicit model.
SpringOffsetProp: The property of a translational spring element SpringOffsetExplicit, linear or nonlinear.
SpringProp: Supplies scalar spring stiffness and optional damping and stress-recovery data.
SpringPropFreq: The frequency dependent or nonlinear properties of the SpringProp with the same ID.
SpringPropTable: The property of a springwhose force-deflection curve is a TableDynamic1.
SpringScalarInline: A scalar spring between two scalar points, with its own stiffness (no property).
SpringScalarProperty: A scalar spring between two scalar points, with a SpringProp property.
StaticLoadSequence: Defines the static load vectors used as the spatial basis of a dynamic load.
SteinbergGuinanYield: The Steinberg-Guinan yield model, for metals over a wide range of strain rates.
StepControlCriteria: Defines target increments or bounds for monitored quantities used by NonlinearStepControl.
StochasticParams: The statistics used to randomize selected model parameters.
SuperelementAccessPoints: The grid points inside an external superelement whose motion the residual structure of the assembly keeps (the access points).
SuperelementBoundarySearch: Grid points of a part superelement for the automatic search of the boundary with another superelement, or with all the others.
SuperelementBulkOptions: The boundary search options of a superelement, and what a repeated, mirrored or collector superelement is.
SuperelementConnection: The boundary connection between two superelements, point by point.
SuperelementCopyPoints: The exterior points of a secondary superelement (an identical or mirror image copy of another one, or one that comes from an external source).
SuperelementCopySequence: The order of the exterior points of a primary superelement that an identical or mirror image copy of it follows.
SuperelementDesignLink: Defines a linear relationship between design variables belonging to different superelements.
SuperelementDesignResp2: A response computed from design variables, constants and responses of several part superelements, by a DesignEquation equation or by a function, as a DesignResp2 does for one model.
SuperelementDesignResp3: An external response, computed by a routine of the user from design variables, constants and responses of several part superelements, as a DesignResp3 does for one model.
SuperelementElemTransfer: Elements that a superelement takes from the one downstream of it.
SuperelementExcludedNodes: Grid points of a part superelement that are left out of its connection to another superelement, or to all the others.
SuperelementExteriorPoints: The exterior points of a primary superelement.
SuperelementExternalBoundary: The boundary connection of an external superelement.
SuperelementFixedDofSet: Degrees of freedom of the exterior points of a superelement that are fixed (b-set) in the component mode synthesis.
SuperelementFixedDofSet1: The degrees of freedom C of a list of exterior points of a superelement that are fixed (b-set).
SuperelementFreeDofSet: Degrees of freedom of the exterior points of a superelement that are free (c-set) in the component mode synthesis.
SuperelementFreeDofSet1: The degrees of freedom C of a list of exterior points of a superelement that are free (c-set).
SuperelementGeneralizedDofSet: The generalized degrees of freedom (q-set) a superelement uses in the generalized dynamic reduction or the component mode synthesis.
SuperelementGeneralizedDofSet1: The degrees of freedom C of a list of points that a superelement uses as generalized degrees of freedom (q-set).
SuperelementGeneralizedPointCount: How many scalar points a superelement generates for its dynamic reduction.
SuperelementInteriorNodes: The interior grid points of a (list) superelement.
SuperelementLabel: The label a superelement carries in the headings of the output.
SuperelementLoadCombination: A static load that combines the load vectors the StaticLoadSequence cards define for a superelement.
SuperelementLoadScale: Selects and scales the loads of external superelements.
SuperelementLocation: Where a part superelement is placed, by three of its points and the three points they go to.
SuperelementMirrorPlane: The mirror plane of a part superelement, by three points.
SuperelementReferenceRotor: The reference rotor of the non-reference rotors of any superelement, for a complex eigenvalue analysis.
SuperelementReleasedDofs: Degrees of freedom of exterior grid points of a superelement that its connection leaves free.
SuperelementSupport: The fictitious supports of a superelement, the determinate reactions of a free-body analysis.
SuperelementTree: The superelements that are upstream of one, which gives the order of the reduction.
SuperelementUserDofSet: Degrees of freedom of a superelement in a set the user names.
SuperelementUserDofSet1: The degrees of freedom C of a list of points of a superelement in a set the user names.
SurfaceEdge: Declares how the surface continues across an edge between two nodes. A declaration may apply to one incident element when its state permits this.
SurfaceFacet: Declares an existing shell element to be a flat facet bounded by straight folds. The element ID also identifies its declaration.
SurfaceLine: Declares the path or end of a surface line through an ordered sequence of grid points.
SurfacePermeability: The permeability of an EulerLagrangeCoupling or GasBag (sub)surface, the velocity of the gas that flows through it as a function of the pressure difference between the inside and the environment (a linear law, or a table).
TableDynamic1: A function y(x) for dynamic loads (of time or of frequency), given by points.
TableDynamic2: A function of x - X1 for dynamic loads, given by points: y = yT(x - X1).
TableDynamic3: A function of (x - X1) / X2 for dynamic loads, given by points: y = yT((x - X1) / X2).
TableDynamic4: A polynomial for dynamic loads, y = sum of Ai * ((x - X1) / X2)^i for i = 0 to N, where x is first brought into [X3, X4].
TableDynamic5: A function f(x, y) of two variables for dynamic loads, given by a TableDynamic1 to TableDynamic4 table of y for each of several values of x.
TableFatigueHistory: Defines a cyclic loading history as load values sampled over time for use by FatigueLoad.
TableGustSpectrum: The power spectral density of a gust for an aeroelastic response analysis (referenced by the RandomSpectralDensity cards).
TableHeat1: A function f(y) of one variable for the convection heat transfer coefficient or the Nusselt number that a TableHeatTwoVariables refers to, given by points.
TableHeatTwoVariables: The heat transfer coefficient or the Nusselt number as a function of two variables, as a series of TableHeat1 tables, each for one value of the first variable.
TableMaterial1: A function y(x) for material properties (of temperature), given by points.
TableMaterial2: A function of x - X1 for material properties, given by points: y = yT(x - X1).
TableMaterial3: A function of (x - X1) / X2 for material properties, given by points: y = yT((x - X1) / X2).
TableMaterial4: A polynomial for material properties, y = sum of Ai * ((x - X1) / X2)^i for i = 0 to N, where x is first brought into [X3, X4].
TableModalDamping1: Modal damping as a function of natural frequency.
TableMultiVariable0: Represents a tabulated function of one independent variable.
TableMultiVariable1: Defines a function of up to four independent variables on a grid, with an ordered array of response values.
TableMultiVariable2: Defines a function of up to four variables by giving the coordinates of the grid and a function value for each grid point.
TableRandomSpectrum1: A power spectral density as a function of frequency, G(F), for random analysis (referenced by the RandomSpectralDensity cards).
TableScattered3D: Represents a function sampled at scattered points in three dimensions for a general coordinate system.
TableStress1: A function y(x) for stress dependent material properties (the stress-strain curve of an IsoMatStressDependent, the creep parameters of a CreepMat, the test data of a HyperelasticPolynomialMat), given by points.
TableStressTemperature: The stress dependent tables of a nonlinear elastic material at several temperatures.
TableTimeHistoryFile: Defines a function of time using a channel in an external history file identified by UserFileName.
TableUserRoutine: A function that a user subroutine computes where a table would give it, so that a card of the explicit solver can name it by number like a table.
TanimuraMimuraYield: The Tanimura-Mimura yield model, for metals over a wide range of strain rates.
TankTestInflator: An inflator described by what a tank test measured: the pressure in the tank against time gives the mass flow rate and the temperature of the gas that the inflator blows into a GasBag or an Euler coupling surface (EulerLagrangeCoupling) through the InflatorInlet that names the card.
TemperatureBoundary: The temperature boundary conditions of a heat transfer analysis.
TemperatureTimeGroup: A group of grid points that share one time function.
TiltingPadBearingProp: Supplies tilting-pad journal bearing data to the external service associated with a two-dimensional bushing.
TimeTemperatureLoad: Defines a temperature history by combining a spatial temperature field with a time-dependent scale.
TimeToSpectrum: The conversion of time histories to power spectral densities, the Fast Fourier Transformation that a random vibration fatigue analysis uses when its loads are given as time signals.
TireSelection: The selection of the external tire models that take part in a simulation.
TransferFunction: Relates a dependent degree of freedom to independent inputs using coefficients of the value and its first two time derivatives.
TransferPathSetup: The set-up of a transfer path analysis (TPA).
TransientFormulaLoad2: A transient excitation given by a formula, for T1 <= t <= T2 and zero elsewhere: P(t) = A * t'^B * exp(C * t') * cos(2 * pi * F * t' + P),  with t' = t - T1 - tau.
TransientInitialCondition: The initial displacement and velocity of one degree of freedom of a transient analysis.
TransientTableLoad1: A transient excitation P(t) = A * F(t - tau), where F is a table.
TransientTimeSteps: The time steps of a linear transient analysis.
TrimComponentCoupling: How a (3D, finite element) trim component, a layer of porous or elastic material of a car interior, is coupled to the structure and to the acoustic cavities, and which of its degrees of freedom are constrained.
TrimComponentCoupling1D: How a 1D analytical trim component (a layered porous material, TrimLayeredComponent, that has no finite element mesh of its own) is coupled to the structure and to the cavities.
TrimCouplingTolerances: The tolerances with which the interface coupling matrices of a trim component are computed when the meshes at the interface do not match.
TrimLayeredComponent: The layers of a 1D analytical trim component (a stack of porous or elastic materials with no mesh of its own), listed from the bottom one.
TrimmedMaterialMatrices: The trimmed material matrices that an acoustic program exports for a frequency response analysis, with the complex factor that scales them.
Tube2: A tension-compression-torsion tube element between two grid points.
TubeProp: The property of a thin-walled cylindrical tube (Tube2).
TypedListSet3: A list of grid points, elements, points, properties or modules that other cards refer to.
UserCompositeFailureMat: An orthotropic material of shell composites with its failure model and property degradation, whose failure is computed by a user subroutine.
UserDefined1: The connection of a user dummy element of number 1, an element whose stiffness, mass and output are computed by routines the user links into the solver.
UserDefined1Attributes: The attributes of the user dummy element number 1, whose connection is a UserDefined1 card and whose property is a UserDefined1Prop card.
UserDefined1Prop: Supplies the property data for UserDefined1 elements. The user element determines the meaning of the property values.
UserDefined2: The connection of a user dummy element of number 2, an element whose stiffness, mass and output are computed by routines the user links into the solver.
UserDefined2Attributes: The attributes of the user dummy element number 2, whose connection is a UserDefined2 card and whose property is a UserDefined2Prop card.
UserDefined2Prop: Supplies the property data for UserDefined2 elements. The user element determines the meaning of the property values.
UserDefined3: The connection of a user dummy element of number 3, an element whose stiffness, mass and output are computed by routines the user links into the solver.
UserDefined3Attributes: The attributes of the user dummy element number 3, whose connection is a UserDefined3 card and whose property is a UserDefined3Prop card.
UserDefined3Prop: Supplies the property data for UserDefined3 elements. The user element determines the meaning of the property values.
UserDefined4: The connection of a user dummy element of number 4, an element whose stiffness, mass and output are computed by routines the user links into the solver.
UserDefined4Attributes: The attributes of the user dummy element number 4, whose connection is a UserDefined4 card and whose property is a UserDefined4Prop card.
UserDefined4Prop: Supplies the property data for UserDefined4 elements. The user element determines the meaning of the property values.
UserDefined5: The connection of a user dummy element of number 5, an element whose stiffness, mass and output are computed by routines the user links into the solver.
UserDefined5Attributes: The attributes of the user dummy element number 5, whose connection is a UserDefined5 card and whose property is a UserDefined5Prop card.
UserDefined5Prop: Supplies the property data for UserDefined5 elements. The user element determines the meaning of the property values.
UserDefined6: The connection of a user dummy element of number 6, an element whose stiffness, mass and output are computed by routines the user links into the solver.
UserDefined6Attributes: The attributes of the user dummy element number 6, whose connection is a UserDefined6 card and whose property is a UserDefined6Prop card.
UserDefined6Prop: Supplies the property data for UserDefined6 elements. The user element determines the meaning of the property values.
UserDefined7: The connection of a user dummy element of number 7, an element whose stiffness, mass and output are computed by routines the user links into the solver.
UserDefined7Attributes: The attributes of the user dummy element number 7, whose connection is a UserDefined7 card and whose property is a UserDefined7Prop card.
UserDefined7Prop: Supplies the property data for UserDefined7 elements. The user element determines the meaning of the property values.
UserDefined8: The connection of a user dummy element of number 8, an element whose stiffness, mass and output are computed by routines the user links into the solver.
UserDefined8Attributes: The attributes of the user dummy element number 8, whose connection is a UserDefined8 card and whose property is a UserDefined8Prop card.
UserDefined8Prop: Supplies the property data for UserDefined8 elements. The user element determines the meaning of the property values.
UserDefined9: The connection of a user dummy element of number 9, an element whose stiffness, mass and output are computed by routines the user links into the solver.
UserDefined9Attributes: The attributes of the user dummy element number 9, whose connection is a UserDefined9 card and whose property is a UserDefined9Prop card.
UserDefined9Prop: Supplies the property data for UserDefined9 elements. The user element determines the meaning of the property values.
UserDofSet: Degrees of freedom of a set that the user names.
UserDofSet1: The degrees of freedom C of a list of points in a set that the user names.
UserElemService: Connects a two-dimensional bushing property to the user routine supplying its stiffness, mass and damping.
UserEnforcedVelocity: Enforced velocities at grid points that a user subroutine computes.
UserFailureModel: A failure model that a user subroutine computes.
UserFileName: Associates a file path with an identifier that other records use to locate external data.
UserMat: The generic properties of a user defined material (hypoelastic or user material model); the UserMatService card with the same ID activates the user subroutine.
UserMatService: Associates a material with its user-supplied constitutive routine.
UserMatTable: The table variation of the properties of a UserMat.
UserServiceData: Integer, real and character data that is handed to the notify method of a user service at the start and the end of a load case and of an increment.
UserShearModel: A shear model whose modulus is computed by a user subroutine.
UserStateEquation: An equation of state computed by a user subroutine.
UserStateVariables: Declares the number and names of state variables carried by a user material routine.
UserYield: A yield model that a user subroutine computes.
ViewFactorFace: The radiation cavity and the shadowing of a surface element face, for the view factor calculation.
ViewFactorIntegration: The parameters of the Gaussian integration method of view factor calculation for one radiation cavity.
ViscoElasticMat: The viscoelastic properties of a material as a Prony series (it extends an IsoMat, AxisymOrthoMat, OrthoMat2D, OrthoMat3DNonlinear or HyperelasticMat).
ViscoElasticMatTemperature: The temperature dependent viscoelastic properties of the material of the ViscoElasticMat with the same ID.
ViscoPlasticMat: The viscoplastic or creep properties of the material of the IsoMat, AnisoMat2D, OrthoMat3DNonlinear or AnisoMat3D with the same ID.
ViscousDamper2: A viscous damper between two grid points, with a ViscousDamperProp property.
ViscousDamperProp: Defines translational and rotational damping coefficients for a viscous damper.
ViscousDamperPropNonlinear: The property of a nonlinear damper whose force depends on the velocity through a TableDynamic1 (the x values of the table are velocities, the y values forces; the values between are interpolated).
VonMisesYield: The von Mises yield model with isotropic hardening.
Weld: A weld or fastener between two surface patches, a point and a patch, or two points.
WeldProp: The property of a connector element (Weld).
WettedElemNodes: A wetted element of an external fluid-structure simulation, given by its shape and its grid points.
WettedElemSide: A wetted element of an external fluid-structure simulation, given as a side of a structural element.
WettedSurface: A wetted surface of a fluid-structure co-simulation, a list of wetted elements.
WettedSurfaceLoad: The load set that stands for an external fluid-structure service, with the wetted surface the service loads.
